title: [E-Document Core] Grant Execute on the status factbox, PDF preview and Navigate handler
summary: The E-Document Core permission set now grants Execute permission on the status factbox page, picture preview page, and navigate handler codeunit to prevent permission errors when users access E-Document components on standard pages.
key_points: Added Execute permission on Page 6187 (E-Doc. Status FactBox), Page 6111 (Inbound E-Doc. Picture), and Codeunit 6247 (E-Doc. Navigate Handler) to the E-Document Core permission set
Resolves error messages for users with custom permission sets lacking page wildcards when opening Sales Orders with E-Document components
These objects are embedded as parts on 25 standard pages but were missing from the permission set
Added test to verify the permission set includes Execute on these objects
Affects E-Document Core and inherited roles like E-Document Core - Read, User, Admin, Edit, and Basic
